_comment: OpenRouter model slugs. Keyed by catalog apiModelId. Kept as data, not TypeScript literals, so the no-hardcoded-model-id lint rule stays meaningful in source. Two tests keep it honest against models.json: every key must exist in the catalog, and every catalog chat model must have an entry. Slugs are read from https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models, never guessed - the namespaces are not derivable (moonshotai, x-ai, z-ai) and Anthropic uses dots where the catalog uses dashes.
